originalP0.finding: Actual original scorer consumed an identified empty received forest and the same empty ui_elements list as its original predicate. DeskClock passes activity gate, Start false/count0 returns false at line63; raw scorer0 equals saved0 despite paused-zero UI. Loss starts at creation before quit; later constructor-worker NPE is a separate failure.

capabilityProtection.finding: OriginalP1 uses same original APK with actual upstream/returned target capability true; stable bound forwarder/PID and 850 nonempty receives, selected846, original predicate true and reward1. OriginalP0 omits capability, becomes unbound and has 301 empty receives. This supports capability protection/coexistence in these sampled runs, not a population success rate or measured final numeric UiAutomation flags.

patchedRecoveryWithoutCapability.finding: When unbound during session, the current capture worker stops and host receives stop instead of receiving empty forests. At quit a new service instance in same process starts a new worker on retained endpoint, and nonempty trees resume and are actually scored. TID31303 reuse is coroutine dispatcher reuse, not old-worker continuity. This proves an observed stop/reconnect recovery mechanism in this APK, not isolation of lifecycle source changes from build-stack differences.

patchedProtection.actionDifference: 4 actions: Search click, input Clock, Clock click, Stopwatch tab click; other cells use drawer swipe, Clock click, Stopwatch tab click. No Start/Pause click, but navigation and observation/timing are not identical.

limits: One trial per cell and fixed order; no reward-based rerun; not randomized replicated causal effect estimation.
New versus original APK includes build-stack/signing/proto/default differences; reward2x2 does not isolate a pure lifecycle patch effect.
ClockPatchedP1 uses different launcher navigation and 4 actions; no claim of fully matched trajectories.
Trace/prequit RecoveryRuntime read-only observations/postquit captures add variable delay; not a precise replay of historical timing.
Only the original official get_state object/list is scoring evidence; Appium XML parsing is supplemental, not substituted official input.
Original sender metadata is empty: no retroactive per-service-instance/generation or individual payload mapping.

Host receipt age is not sender generation age. Device time can be reset by official initialization; use sampled device-date bounds, log order and host monotonic timestamps, not raw cross-clock epoch subtraction.
Native Init flags=0 is preserved. AOSP callback/connect assignment ordering is an explanation possibility, not device measurement of final flags=1.
The experimental failed-build gRPC default defect is separate and must not be retroactively assigned to original APK/campaign.
Historical007 lacks the actual official input: no unique historical root-cause claim or historical score rewrite.

Top cleanup is closed and per-session absence proven; nested verification.status remains raw unknown in saved records, not rewritten. Zero unknownCreationOutcomeCount and completed agent quit separately establish the observed cleanup facts.
regressionAcceptance: separate independent regression review to follow; not included in this four-cell scope
